2607.05952.title: Signed-Graph Recommendation as Structural Consistency Maximization
2607.05952.paper_summary: While signed social recommendation has shown great potential by modeling both trust and distrust relations, its effectiveness is often hindered by structural noise and data sparsity. In this work, we first identify a fundamental inconsistency across the structural, propagation, and semantic layers of existing models, which leads to biased representations learned from sparse or noisy datasets. Furthermore, we observe that most existing methods treat the observed graph as fixed, failing to bridge the gap between noisy topologies and reliable social semantics. To address these issues, we propose a unified framework named SSC-Loop that treats signed social recommendation as the maximization of structural consistency. SSC-Loop includes three dedicated modules: ESA-DA for structural consistency, a P/N/O propagation mechanism for propagation consistency, and a contrastive learning objective for semantic consistency. Experiments on Epinions demonstrate that SSC-Loop achieves strong performance on explicit signed social rating prediction, while auxiliary results on Slashdot under a derived link-existence setting further suggest its ability to exploit signed social structures. Source code is available at https://github.com/Refrainwww/SSC-Loop.
2607.05952.paper_summary_zh: 雖然簽名社交推薦在建模信任和不信任關係方面顯示出巨大的潛力，但其有效性常常受到結構噪聲和數據稀疏的阻礙。在這項工作中，我們首先識別出現有模型在結構、傳播和語義層面上的基本不一致性，這導致從稀疏或噪聲數據集中學習到的偏見表示。此外，我們觀察到大多數現有方法將觀察到的圖視為固定，未能弥合噪聲拓撲和可靠社交語義之間的差距。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一個名為 SSC-Loop 的統一框架，將簽名社交推薦視為結構一致性的最大化。SSC-Loop 包含三個專門的模塊：用於結構一致性的 ESA-DA，一個用於傳播一致性的 P/N/O 傳播機制，以及一個用於語義一致性的對比學習目標。在 Epinions 上的實驗表明，SSC-Loop 在顯式簽名社交評分預測方面表現出色，而在派生的連接存在設置下對 Slashdot 的輔助結果進一步表明其利用簽名社交結構的能力。源代碼可在 https://github.com/Refrainwww/SSC-Loop 獲得。
